This verdict tests (a) whether the loop, as a self-learning object, escapes the record, and (b) whether the residual "trial accountant / null calibrator" claim and its kill experiment survive.

strongest_objection: The kill experiment cannot PASS under any hypothesis the record supports, so even the residual "trial accountant" row produces no information. Compute the design's own gate (iii) with its own inputs: on the PIT span (7.7 yr, 2800 decisions, POWERED_RESULT.md) σ_SR = 1/√7.7 = 0.36 annualised; Bailey–López de Prado eq.1 at N = 25,000 gives SR₀ = 0.36 × (0.4228·3.94 + 0.5772·4.18) ≈ +1.47 annualised; DSR ≥ 0.95 then needs (SR − SR₀)·√(T−1) ≥ 1.645 in daily units, i.e. SR ≥ 0.077 + 0.031 = 0.108/day ≈ +2.07 annualised (worse with crypto skew/kurtosis). At the proposer's "honest" budget N = 200: SR₀ ≈ +1.00, pass needs ≈ +1.59. On the goalpost window alone (2.5 yr, σ_SR = 0.63) even N = 10 needs ≈ +2.04. The best daily book ever measured PIT on this panel reads +0.56 CI[−0.13,+1.23] (POWERED_RESULT.md); the bar is +0.97. So the gate demands 2× the bar and 3–4× the best measured book: the experiment is a FAIL-generator with ≈0 power, and the proposal's "P(PASS) ≈ 2–4%" contradicts its own arithmetic. Everything else in the design that was supposed to separate signal from selection is hollow or under-powered: CPCV protects nothing for parameter-free rules (the "train" groups fit nothing, so selection over 25,000 candidates on the median OOS-path Sharpe is fully in-sample over 2018–2025 — 813's disjoint selection/hold-out split, MAP_PREREGISTERED.md → PHASE1_5_RESULT.md, was the stronger design and still inverted +5.81 → −4.08); the 6-month 2026H1 hold-out has σ_SR ≈ 1.4 (proposal's own number; 875 measured OOS seed spread 1.02–1.99 on half-year windows) so criterion (i) passes a true-zero rule ~25% of the time and a true +0.97 rule ~50%; and Arm R runs ONE seed of a stochastic search on ONE hold-out window, which docs/pathway.md:11,20-21 ("≥3 seeds … Nothing promotes past a gate on one seed or one window") forbids promoting. What is left is the placebo — White's Reality Check on the repo's scorer — which is the same test TASK_915 runs on the same information with strictly more power (per-date cross-sectional IC, SE ≈ 1/√(N_eff·D), Bonferroni over 160 pre-registered cells) instead of one book's Sharpe (SE ≈ 1/√D) taxed by 25,000 correlated trials.
amplifier_check: AMPLIFIER ONLY — and on a null surface a noise maximiser, not a neutral amplifier. Mechanism: fitness = net@21 Sharpe of positions computed from causal features on the same historical return panel; the archive is a selected subset of a fixed, finite grammar; every bit of market information in it entered through the return series, so its content is bounded above by the IC of its terminals (a hard-thresholded, sign-quantised forecast has ≤ the information of the continuous forecast it thresholds — memo §1.3 TC 0.5–0.7). The only genuinely new object is the SELECTION RECORD (N_evaluated, V[SR], descriptor coverage) — meta-information about the search, worth exactly a diagnostic. Under H0 the loop's expected best element is E[max SR_N] > 0 by construction (≈ +1.0 at N=10 on 2.5 yr; ≈ +1.0 at N=200 on 7.7 yr), i.e. it amplifies noise into a bar-clearing in-sample number; the record has already observed this law twice on this class: 813 best-of-132 fire Sharpe +5.81 (n_events 6) → hold-out −4.08 (PHASE1_MAP_PROBE.md:20-22; PHASE1_5_RESULT.md:6-25) and 819 best-of-8 +0.97 failing BH q=0.05 (PORTFOLIO_RESULT.md:89-97) then PIT +0.56 (POWERED_RESULT.md). MC/Bella enters only as the null — correctly, since generated data measured 0-for-3 NULL (best +0.13pp, encoder_bella_class_closed.md:9-16) and the one real learned grammar (candle LM 7.61 vs bigram 8.19 bits/tok) moved alpha +0.12pp against a +3pp bar (candle_language.md:86-100). The proposer's own statement — "the loop itself contributes none of the three [forecast, premium, cost reduction]; it is a sampler over G plus an accountant" — is confirmed. The design therefore does not answer the operator's question in the affirmative: there is no pattern the loop can learn "to serve Monte Carlo" that a direct IC estimator on the same terminals does not already contain, and 915 (D79-adopted, QUEUE row) is that estimator.

surviving_claim: Three things survive, none of them the operator's hoped-for loop. (1) FACT, now quantified for the program: on this panel any selection among ≥10 rule trials needs an annualised Sharpe of ≈ +1.6 to +2.1 to be distinguishable from luck (E[max SR_N] at σ_SR = 1/√T_years; SR₀ ≈ +1.0 at N=10 on the 2.5-yr goalpost window, at N=200 on the 7.7-yr PIT span), and the record's two best-cell numbers (813: +5.81 → −4.08; 819: +0.97 → 0/8 FDR → PIT +0.56) sit inside what pure selection produces. This is why the direction memo's IC statistic (TASK_915: per-date cross-sectional IC, NW t ≥ 3, Bonferroni over 160 pre-registered cells) and not any book-Sharpe search is the right instrument for the load-bearing doubt: it tests the same information with SE ≈ 1/√(N_eff·D) instead of 1/√D and pays no search multiplicity. (2) TWO REPORTING REQUIREMENTS, not a row: (a) every future rule grid or tactic library states N_evaluated and E[max SR_N | null] / DSR next to its best cell (≈40 lines added to trader/backtest.py alongside bh_fdr :57); (b) a common-offset label-decoupled placebo (positions from real features on returns shifted ≥365 d) as the empirical null for tactics-panel row 1 and as a second read on 915's Bonferroni — new code, order 100–200 lines, CPU-minutes for a K≈8 library. (3) A CONDITIONAL: a SMALL hashed gated grammar (N ≤ 50, IF vol-regime/VR-flag AND trend/reversal) is not forbidden by the record IF the tactics panel's VR-persistence diagnostic reads nonzero AND 915 G-A passes for a gated cell — but it should be graded by IC, not book Sharpe, and its output is an auditability concession (TC 0.5–0.7 vs the Gârleanu–Pedersen book on the same forecast), never an edge source. Verdict on the operator's question: no self-learning loop design that learns "patterns to serve Monte Carlo" on daily OHLC escapes the record; the loop's learned object is worth exactly the deflated Sharpe of its best element, which at IC ≈ 0 is the cost drag (≈ −0.15..−0.28/regime) plus a diagnostic count. Bella/generated paths belong only in the null (D5 resident role); 'Bella as world-model rollouts inside MCTS' (encoder_bella_class_closed.md:29, TASK_778 BLOCKED stub) remains untested but the memo §5 argument stands — a generator calibrated to the data carries no drift information beyond what a forecaster extracts, and the bottleneck is the conditional mean.
kill_experiment_critique: The experiment as written is not two-sided. (1) NO POWER: gate (iii) DSR ≥ 0.95 at N=25,000 needs elite SR ≈ +2.1 annualised on the PIT span (SR₀ ≈ +1.47); no supported H1 reaches it (best PIT daily book +0.56, bar +0.97). Even at N=200 it needs ≈ +1.6. Fix: either drop the analytic DSR and rely on the placebo alone, or cut N to what the span supports (MinBTL: ≤45 independent configurations for 5 years at E[max]=1) — and note that a grammar of ≤45 hashed cells is a pre-registered grid, not an evolutionary loop, i.e. the fix dissolves the design into tactics-panel row 1. (2) CPCV IS HOLLOW HERE: rules have no fitted parameters, so purge/embargo and 'OOS paths' are a partition of one full-sample evaluation; the fitness sees every return the hold-out excludes except 2026H1. If selection-vs-evaluation separation is wanted, use 813's disjoint-span design (select on 2018–2023, grade on 2024–2026H1 once) and accept the power loss honestly. (3) GATE (i) IS NOT A GATE: 2026H1 (≈180 decisions, σ_SR ≈ 1.4) cannot separate +0.97 from 0; 875's half-year OOS spread 1.02–1.99 is the in-repo measurement of that. (4) ONE REAL SEED violates pathway.md:11,20-21; a MAP-Elites run needs ≥3 seeds of the search itself, and the archive's seed-to-seed overlap should be reported (it is the honest N_eff proxy the proposal says is missing). (5) PLACEBO: 20 seeds ⇒ '95th percentile' is the max of 20, P(real > max | H0) ≈ 1/21 — acceptable, but the 200 CPU-hours placebo dominates cost for a 5% test; the common-offset shift on a span where BULL21/BEAR22 dominate makes the placebo best-of-archive distribution regime-alignment-luck-dominated (wide), so it may also fail a true signal; the proposal's own open doubt (placebo book vol ≠ real book vol) must enter pass/fail as a matched-vol check, not remain a doubt. (6) FLAT FLOOR GAMING: a 1/n long book satisfies gross ≥ 0.5 and is caught only by the in-sample BEAR22 form check; the β-hedged constant-mix control arm must be a hard requirement. (7) GRAMMAR LEAK: H ∈ {1,2,3,5} and hysteresis are cost-reduction levers owned by tactics-panel row 2 (H=3d already reads +0.90 PIT vs +0.56, POWERED_RESULT.md robustness table); inside G they will be selected and reported as edge — pre-register their exclusion or attribute them separately. (8) SEQUENTIAL REDUNDANCY, the decisive point: the pre-committed reading 'if 915 G-A has FAILED, do not run' is correct, and on G-A PASS the GP closed-form book (915 G-C) is the higher-TC harvester of the same cell, so neither branch of 915 leaves a decision this experiment would change. By the pathway's own ratio (odds shift / cost to falsify, memo §3) it should not be a row; its two reusable residues (trial counter + DSR report; common-offset placebo) belong in 915's SPEC and row 1 as reporting requirements. Instrument, epoch pin (post-E-d, 899 ingest), and compute claims (CPU-only; 82.2 s per full cell_metrics with 2000-boot CI, POWERED_RESULT.md) are consistent with the record and are not objected to.
